topic: Which answer would you give: disagreeing with your manager

beats.narration: One interview question. Two answers. Only one gets the offer.
Tell me about a time you disagreed with your manager.
Answer A. I pushed back hard in the team meeting, and they agreed to wait. Sounds confident. But it says you fight in public.
Answer B. Testing needed four weeks, not two. I asked for fifteen minutes one on one, showed the bugs from our last rushed release, and we shipped the core on time. No rollbacks.
B wins. Specific, calm, and it ends with a result.
Practise yours out loud with Prept, and get a score out of ten. Which would you give? Comment A or B.
